mapper.sql: a.asset_id, a.asset_cd, a.asset_type, a.asset_nm, a.serial_no, a.item_id, it.item_cd, it.item_nm, a.life_shots, a.calib_cycle_days, a.last_calib_date, case when a.calib_cycle_days is not null and a.last_calib_date is not null then a.last_calib_date + a.calib_cycle_days end as next_calib_date, a.use_yn, a.remark, a.row_ver, a.updated_at, a.updated_by, cur.install_id as cur_install_id, ce.equip_cd as cur_equip_cd, ce.equip_nm as cur_equip_nm, cur.installed_at as cur_installed_at

from mst_phys_asset a left join mst_item it on it.item_id = a.item_id left join mst_asset_install cur on cur.asset_id = a.asset_id and cur.removed_at is null and cur.void_yn = 'N' left join mst_equip ce on ce.equip_id = cur.equip_id

order by
